description: Use when an agent has raw RPC output and must read it as a number or as text: converts between hex, decimal and UTF-8 in one call, with big integers kept exact because a 32-byte word overflows a JavaScript number. Do not use to decode a whole ABI-encoded struct: this converts one value. No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

as.description: hex | decimal | text. What the value IS. Defaults to autodetect.

value.description: A 0x-prefixed hex string, a decimal number, or text.

name: util_hex
title: Hex converter
